record.original_question: Call a countable Borel equivalence relation E hyperfinite-over-hyperfinite (hf/hf) if there is a Borel partial order ≤ on its space X such that x ≤ y implies x E y, and the restriction of ≤ to each E-class is a suborder of Z^2. If E is hf/hf, must E be hyperfinite?

evidence.quote: we call a countable Borel equivalence relation hyperfinite-over-hyperfinite (or shortly, hf/hf) if there is a Borel partial order ≤ on X such that (i) if x ≤ y, then xEy, (ii) the order type of ≤↾[x] is a suborder of Z2.
Problem 37 (The hf/hf problem). If E is hf/hf, is it hyperfinite?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A countable Borel equivalence relation on a standard Borel space X is an equivalence relation E ⊆ X × X that is Borel as a subset of X × X and each of whose equivalence classes is countable. Such an E is called hyperfinite if it can be written as an increasing union E = ⋃_n F_n of Borel equivalence relations F_n with all classes finite.

Let ≤_{Z^2} denote the coordinatewise partial order on Z × Z, i.e. (a,b) ≤_{Z^2} (c,d) iff a ≤ c and b ≤ d.

Call a countable Borel equivalence relation E on X hyperfinite-over-hyperfinite (hf/hf) if there exists a Borel partial order ≤ on X such that:
(i) x ≤ y implies x E y, and
(ii) for every x ∈ X, the restriction of ≤ to the E-class [x]_E is order-isomorphic to a suborder of (Z × Z, ≤_{Z^2}).

Question: Must every hyperfinite-over-hyperfinite countable Borel equivalence relation be hyperfinite?
artifact.status_search_result: The hf/hf problem appears to be open. Recent work (arXiv:2404.17516, "An order analysis of hyperfinite Borel equivalence relations") explicitly states it is unknown whether hyperfinite-over-hyperfinite equivalence relations are hyperfinite, and obtains only partial results (e.g., hyperfiniteness under an additional self-compatibility assumption on the Z^2-ordering).

status_evidence.title: An order analysis of hyperfinite Borel equivalence relations
status_evidence.snippet: hyperfinite-over-hyperfinite equivalence relations... it is unknown whether the two notions are equivalent
status_evidence.claim: The hf/hf problem is stated as open, with partial progress under extra compatibility hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: The Union Problem: Are hyper-hyperfinite Borel equivalence relations hyperfinite?
status_evidence.snippet: open problem regarding whether hyper-hyperfinite implies hyperfinite
status_evidence.claim: The question is listed as an open problem in the literature.
